hooks.command: BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); if [ "$BRANCH" = 'main' ]; then echo '⚠️ REMINDER: Create a feature branch (TAM-{number}-{description}) before making changes.'; fi
echo '📝 REMINDER: Commit format: type(scope): description [TAM-XXX]'

BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current); if [ "$BRANCH" = 'main' ]; then echo '❌ BLOCKER: Cannot push directly to main. Create a feature branch first: git checkout -b TAM-{number}-{description}'; exit 1; fi
if git status --porcelain | grep -q .; then echo '❌ BLOCKER: Uncommitted changes detected. Commit all changes before pushing.'; exit 1; fi

git fetch origin -q 2>/dev/null && git log HEAD..origin/main --oneline 2>/dev/null | grep -q . && echo '⚠️ WARNING: Branch is behind origin/main. Consider rebasing first: git rebase origin/main' || true
echo '📋 REMINDER: Run /pre-pr for complete validation first (pnpm verify + codegen freshness)!'

FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); case "$FILE" in *CLAUDE.md|*CONTRIBUTING.md|*AGENTS.md|*README.md) echo '📚 REMINDER: High-impact doc modified. Update related documentation in this PR.';; esac

echo '🚀 SAW harness active — tickets are in-repo specs (specs/TAM-N-*.md). Key commands: /start-work /check-workflow /pre-pr /end-work. Full list: .claude/README.md'; bash .claude/hooks/session-start-pattern-check.sh 2>/dev/null || true
git status --porcelain | grep -q . && echo '⚠️ Session ending with uncommitted changes. Use /end-work to complete cleanly.' || echo '✅ Clean session end - no uncommitted changes'
